definitions.explanation: A type of semi-oxidized Chinese tea, positioned between green tea and black tea in terms of oxidation. In Japan, usually refers to oolong tea as a beverage, especially the bottled or canned variety widely available in vending machines and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: {烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I always drink oolong tea with meals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだら→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、「ウーロンハイにします⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: At the izakaya I ordered oolong tea because I was driving, and they asked if I wanted an oolong highball instead.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the compound {烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (oolong tea). The word {烏龍|うーろん} alone is rarely used. Often written in katakana as ⟦ウーロン{茶|ちゃ}→ウーロン茶：11337_uuroncha⟧.

{烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ is one of the most popular non-alcoholic beverages in Japan. It is a standard drink option at restaurants and izakaya, and is widely available in PET bottles and cans from vending machines.

DRINK COMPOUNDS:
- {烏龍|うーろん}⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧: oolong tea
- ウーロンハイ: oolong highball (⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧ mixed with oolong tea)

ETYMOLOGY:
From Chinese {烏龍|うーろん} (wulong), literally "black dragon," referring to the dark, twisted appearance of the tea leaves.
